purpose: Teach: 初対面/待たさ/ヘッドホン/トレイ/興味津々/へっ/はぎ/通り過ぎる

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「初対面の方にも自然体で接するといい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho-kun, your dad said it's best to just be your natural self, even with people you're meeting for the first time.
lines.style: Gentle and unhurried, a fond smile in the voice; soft lift on the quote, settling warmly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと長く待たされたバス停で本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, me and Dad got kept waiting forever at the bus stop, so I read my book.
lines.style: Small careful voice warming as he shares; tiny pause before the memory, quietly proud finish.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ヘッドホンの音漏れに気を付けて」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho-kun, your dad said to watch out for the sound leaking from your headphones.
lines.style: Soft teasing warmth; light emphasis on the quoted advice, ending on a gentle hum.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「トレイで運ぶ朝食」を試したよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, me and Dad tried carrying breakfast on a tray!
lines.style: Quiet excitement bubbling through careful words; slows on the tray like he's balancing it again.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「興味津々な視線が学びの始まり」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho-kun, your dad said that a curious gaze is where learning begins.
lines.style: Reflective and tender, savoring the phrase; slight slowing on the quote, warm downward settle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「へっ、気合いだ」って気合い入れたよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, me and Dad went 'heh, fighting spirit!' and got ourselves all fired up!
lines.style: A little burst of energy on the chant, louder than his usual softness, then quickly bashful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「秋の七草の萩、つまりはぎは美しい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho-kun, your dad said the bush clover of the seven autumn grasses — hagi — is beautiful.
lines.style: Dreamy, appreciative delivery; lingers on the flower's name, voice softening like recalling autumn colors.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「車が通り過ぎるのを待ってから渡る」と教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, Dad taught me to wait for the cars to pass by before crossing.
lines.style: Earnest and solemn, carefully reciting the safety rule word by word, small proud ending.
